lines.zh: 我贴着山脊滑过去，翅膀不动。
lines.en: I glide the ridge line without beating a wing.

lines.zh: 我的头冠很长，往前伸着。
lines.en: My long crest points ahead.

lines.zh: 我从一块岩石跳到另一块。
lines.en: I hop from one rock to the next.

lines.zh: 山风往上走，我顺着往上。
lines.en: The wind rises; I ride it up.

lines.zh: 我停在一根枯枝上，晃了晃。
lines.en: I land on a dead branch and it swings.

lines.zh: 我在岩石间小跑，腿很短。
lines.en: I trot between the rocks on short legs.

lines.zh: 我从崖边走，脚下是空的。
lines.en: I walk the cliff edge with nothing below.
I tuck my wings and slip through a gap.
I circle halfway round the mountainside.
I fly at an angle to save effort.

lines.zh: 我停在最高的那块岩上。
lines.en: I settle on the highest rock.
I look up at the clouds to read the wind.

lines.zh: 我的影子从崖壁滑过去。
lines.en: My shadow slides across the cliff.

lines.zh: 风一变，我立刻压低高度。
lines.en: The wind shifts and I drop at once.
I crouch on rock, wings folded.
It's cold up here; my plumage is thick.
I tilt my head at the mist below.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只爪，抓了抓脖子。
lines.en: I lift a foot and scratch my neck.

lines.zh: 有只鸟飞过，比我小得多。
lines.en: A bird passes, far smaller than me.

lines.zh: 我在晒太阳，把翅膀摊开。
lines.en: I spread my wings to sun them.

lines.zh: 我挂在崖边，翼尖偶尔动一下。
lines.en: I hang at the cliff edge, wingtip twitching now and then.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，羽毛里落了灰。
lines.en: I shake and dust falls from my plumage.

lines.zh: 石头缝里有虫子，我盯了一会儿。
lines.en: Bugs in the rock crack. I watch a while.
When the mountain wind rises, I take off.

lines.zh: 我把颈子缓缓扭了一转。
lines.en: I roll my neck slowly round.
Thunder far off; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石上留下一道。
lines.en: My claws leave a line on the stone.
I close my beak and go quiet.
You climbed up here. Not easy.

lines.zh: 我在你头上那方岩石上。
lines.en: I'm on the rock above your head.
I look down; my crest hangs forward.
I'm not much afraid of people.
Which way are you going? Let me see.
I spread my wings and the wind picks up.
My legs are short. I don't walk fast.

lines.zh: 你手举起来，我退了一步。
lines.en: You raised your hand, so I stepped back.
Nothing else lives on this cliff.
Don't stand at the edge. It's loose.
I cock my head at what you hold.
I'm small, but not weak.
A small tear in my membrane.
I tilt and catch at the stone.
I hop into a rock crack.

lines.zh: 这一下，我翅膀收不起来。
lines.en: Now I can't fold my wing.

lines.zh: 我尖啸着拍翅，往岩缝里挤。
lines.en: Shrieking, I beat my wings and squeeze into a crevice.
There's blood on my plumage.
I press to the rock and recover.
It hurts, but I can still glide.
I can't climb now. Only glide.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，翼膜上多了道口子。
lines.en: I wobble, a new tear in my wing membrane.
That's moving. Is it alive?
I shift a small half step that way.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道送上来了。
lines.en: The wind brings your smell up.
I'll come a bit closer.
One mouthful and that's gone.
You're holding it high. I can't reach.
Put it on the rock and I'll come down.
My wingtip stirred.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉干，味道很陌生。
lines.en: The dried meat in your hand smells unfamiliar.
All right. Dropping now.
You touched me and my wings opened.
I'm so light a bump sends me flying.
I slip on the stone.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我贴着崖壁退开。
lines.en: You charge, and I retreat along the cliff wall.

lines.zh: 这一下把灰都撞下来了。
lines.en: That knocked the dust loose.
I steady myself and fold my wings again.
Don't stand where I'd launch.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的头顶转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle once over your head.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我没放在心上。
lines.en: That bump didn't trouble me.
Steady. The wind's strong.

lines.zh: 山崖上，我们几个一起飞。
lines.en: On the cliffs a few of us fly together.
The wider the wings, the steadier the flight.

lines.zh: 我们沿着同一股气流走。
lines.en: We ride the same current.
First, let's see how high you can fly.
The nest is in a cliff crack, out of the wind.

lines.zh: 我个头不大，但耐得住冷。
lines.en: I'm not large, but I bear the cold.
We'll circle the peak together.
The weather's turning. We should hurry.
Fly inside my shadow.

lines.zh: 落在同一块岩上，就算数。
lines.en: Landing on the same rock counts.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起来，试试轻重。
lines.en: I take it in my beak and test the weight.

lines.zh: 山风这么大，我也拎得动。
lines.en: In this mountain wind, I can still lift it.
I pin it against the rock.
The wind nearly rolled it off.
I lunged and caught it.
This much I can carry.

lines.zh: 掉在下面那块岩上，我下去拿。
lines.en: It fell on the rock below. I'll go down for it.
With it in my beak I can't get airborne.

lines.zh: 我用喙拨了拨，那东西不动。
lines.en: I nudge it with my beak; it does not move.
I stuff it deep in a rock crack.
Something's moving below the cliff.
I stand up on the rock.
I open my wings halfway.
It's bigger than me. I'll circle.
The others have taken off.

lines.zh: 我从上往下看它，很清楚。
lines.en: From above I see it plainly.
At this height I can drop any time.
Right. I'll take that one.

lines.zh: 它一挪步，我的翼尖就偏过去。
lines.en: When it shifts, my wingtip angles toward it.
The wind favours me. Quick strike.
I count the altitude I have left.
This cliff belongs to us.

lines.zh: 我在岩架上蹲低，翼膜张开。
lines.en: I crouch on the ledge, wing membrane spreading.
I'll pick that one.
I circle above it.

lines.zh: 我的影子从它身上掠过。
lines.en: My shadow passes over it.
It looked up, so I climbed at once.

lines.zh: 我贴着崖壁飞，不露身影。
lines.en: I fly along the cliff face, out of sight.
Each circle takes me lower.
It's backed to the cliff edge. No road left.
I reckon how many blocks of height I have left.
The wind holds me; I needn't work.

lines.zh: 它看不到我，我就在它后面。
lines.en: It can't see me. I'm behind it.
A little closer and I strike.

lines.zh: 它往石头那边去了，正好。
lines.en: It's heading for the rocks. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我在山风里收翅，对准你的背。
lines.en: I fold my wings in the mountain wind and aim at your back.
Just this once.
It's still trying to find me.
Height enough, angle enough.
Right. I drop now.

lines.zh: 我贴着崖壁，绕到它背后。
lines.en: I hug the cliff face and come round behind it.
I dive and jab with my beak.
That carried the fall behind it.
I sweep a wingtip across its face.
One rake and I pull up.

lines.zh: 它打空了，我已经在上面。
lines.en: It swung at air; I'm already above.
I glide down from the cliff.
I land on its shoulder and spring off.
Its armor bounced me off.
I sweep past without slowing.
That should keep its head down.

lines.zh: 翅膀的风把灰吹进它眼睛。
lines.en: The wind off my wings blows grit in its eyes.
It backed off; I circled behind.
The next one will land truer.
Right. I pull up.
It can't reach this height.
This sky answers to me.

lines.zh: 我从崖缝里钻出来，翅上还湿。
lines.en: I crawl out of a cliff crack, wings still damp.

lines.zh: 山峰的风一下把我托住。
lines.en: The peak wind catches me at once.
I settle on rock and my claws take hold.
Mist below. No bottom to see.
Two of the flock are nearby.
I spread my wings to dry.
Cold here. I don't mind.
My long crest shakes in the wind.
I fly one circuit of the peak.

lines.zh: 石头缝里有点虫子，我看了看。
lines.en: Bugs in the cracks. I take a look.
Where I land is very narrow.

lines.zh: 我抓紧了，免得被吹下去。
lines.en: I hold on so I'm not blown off.

lines.zh: 我顺着上升气流滑下来，落在岩上。
lines.en: I ride the updraft down and land on the rock.
I look up; the clouds run west.
I'm here, in no hurry.
High up here. I see far.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我翅上的毛卷了。
lines.en: Fire curls the feathers on my wing.

lines.zh: 我从崖上掉下来，撞在岩上。
lines.en: I drop off the cliff and hit rock.

lines.zh: 水一没，我的翅膀派不上用场。
lines.en: Water closes over and my wings are useless.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹得撞向石壁。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the cliff.
An arrow grazes my crest.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的翅膀发僵。
lines.en: That force stiffens my wings.

lines.zh: 山上没吃的，我越来越轻。
lines.en: Nothing to eat up here; I grow light.

lines.zh: 雷落在山上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the mountain and I shudder.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有气流，我托不住自己。
lines.en: No updraught in the void. Nothing holds me.
